events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Claudius, then Nero (from AD 54), is emperor; Ephesus is the leading city of the province of Asia.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written perhaps AD 62 to 64 (if by Paul), after the events of Acts

teaser.title: Paul works in Ephesus
teaser.text: About three years of teaching in the city (Acts 19; 20:31).

teaser.title: 1 Timothy is written
teaser.text: Paul has gone to Macedonia and writes to Timothy in Ephesus (if by Paul).

teaser.title: 2 Timothy and Titus follow
teaser.text: The other two Pastoral Epistles, written to Timothy and to Titus.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
